title: Table Reservation Application
desc: This comprehensive case study detailing the creation of a Table Reservation App, highlighting user objectives, target audience, and a user flow accompanied by wireframes, offering insights into elevating the dining experience through innovative mobile solutions.

title: The Epic Journey of Pinterest's Transformation
desc: This case study highlights Pinterest's transformation from a passive bookmarking platform to an active hub of inspiration and action. Through strategic product innovations, Pinterest has evolved into a dynamic space empowering users to bring their dreams to life.

title: Streamlining Travel Experiences
desc: The case study proposes an app to simplify travel with real-time flight info and digital boarding passes. It aims to enhance user experience by providing personalized guidance and push notifications for stress-free journeys.

title: Fampay Transaction Analysis
desc: The case study investigates a drop in transactions on Fampay, India's teen-centric financial app. It suggests strategic partnerships and user-focused enhancements to reengage the platform's tech-savvy teen audience and bolster usage.
